East Point College of Physiotherapy Bang: The East point group of institutes is located in East Bangalore. It is the premier group of institutions that offers quality education in various disciplines like Humanities, Arts, Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharma, Medical, and Higher Education. It was founded in the year 1998, by the MG Charitable Trust, which is committed to the multi-multicultural and educational aspirations of the society.

East Point College of Higher Education was started in the year 1995. It is affiliated with Bangalore University and the courses are recognized by the Government of Karnataka. Presently, there are around thousand five hundred students pursuing higher educational goals in various commerce and management fields.

The East Point College of Physiotherapy Bangalore is the newest addition to the group. It was founded in the year 2014. There is a modern hospital situated within the campus. It has got seven hundred bed capacity with modern facilities. The hospital looks after the healthcare needs of people around the campus.

After completing three years after incorporation, East Point College of Medical College started to function under the affiliation of the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, along with the approval of the Medical Council of India.
East Point College of Physiotherapy Cour: East Point College of Physiotherapy, Bangalore offers a bachelor’s degree program in physiotherapy. It is also known as BPT and Master’s degree in physiotherapy, MPT.
Bachelors of Physiotherapy: Physiotherapy is a health sciences branch, which applies physical movements like exercises, massages, education, and counseling service, for movement and functioning which has been restricted by age, pain, injury, diseases, disorders, conditions, and other factors. It is a course for a duration of four and a half years. There are compulsory six months of internship which the students are required to do, during the course time.

The syllabus of BPT covers subjects about physiotherapeutic skills like manual exercises, therapeutic exercises, and using electro-physical modalities which proved to be a cure for various types of diseases related to the spine, back, neck, and stress-related problems.
Master of Physiotherapy: Master of Physiotherapy is a post-graduate degree in Physiotherapy, It is a full-time course of 2 years. The college offers different specializations in MPT, such as:
MPT in Cardiovascular and Pulmonary Sciences

Eligibility Criteria: If you are looking to get admitted to the BPT course, then you must satisfy the following criteria:

Students should have passed the pre-university examination (12 th standard), with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in the English language separately. The combined score in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology should be forty percent.
For the SC/ST and OBC students, the combined score should be around thirty-five percent.
Before getting admission, the student is required to furnish a medical fitness certificate from a Government Authorized Medical Officer, stating that he/she is fit to undergo the course.
The minimum age of the student at the time of admission should be seventeen years of age.
If you are looking to get admitted to the MPT course, then you must satisfy the following criteria:
Candidates should have a BSc (PT) or BPT from a recognized university.
Should have scored at least 50% marks in the BPT course and completed the compulsory 6-month internship.
Must obtain the eligibility certificate from the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Karnataka.
